entries.title: Exodus 23:1
segments: ¶Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness. {raise: or, receive}

entries.title: Exodus 23:2
segments: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to [do] evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest [judgment]: {speak: Heb. answer}

entries.title: Exodus 23:3
segments: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

entries.title: Exodus 23:4
segments: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

entries.title: Exodus 23:5
segments: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him. {and...: or, wilt thou cease to help him? or, and wouldest cease to leave thy business for him: thou shalt surely leave it to join with him}

words.text: with him. {and...: or, wilt thou cease to help him? or, and wouldest cease to leave thy business for him: thou shalt surely leave it to join with him}

entries.title: Exodus 23:6
segments: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

entries.title: Exodus 23:7
segments: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

words.text: thou not: for I will not justify

entries.title: Exodus 23:8
segments: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous. {the wise: Heb. the seeing}

entries.title: Exodus 23:9
segments: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt. {heart: Heb. soul}

entries.title: Exodus 23:10
segments: ¶And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

entries.title: Exodus 23:11
segments: But the seventh [year] thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, [and] with thy oliveyard. {oliveyard: or, olive trees}

words.text: . In like manner thou shalt deal

entries.title: Exodus 23:12
segments: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

entries.title: Exodus 23:13
segments: And in all [things] that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

words.text: And in all [things] that I have said

entries.title: Exodus 23:14
segments: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

entries.title: Exodus 23:15
segments: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

words.text: ; for in it thou camest out

entries.title: Exodus 23:16
segments: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, [which is] in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

entries.title: Exodus 23:17
segments: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Exodus 23:18
segments: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning. {sacrifice: or, feast}

entries.title: Exodus 23:19
segments: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

entries.title: Exodus 23:20
segments: ¶Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

entries.title: Exodus 23:21
segments: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name [is] in him.

words.text: him not; for he will not pardon

entries.title: Exodus 23:22
segments: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries. {an adversary...: or, I will afflict them that afflict thee}

words.text: ; then I will be an enemy
. {an adversary...: or, I will afflict them that afflict thee}

entries.title: Exodus 23:23
segments: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

words.text: : and I will cut them off

entries.title: Exodus 23:24
segments: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

entries.title: Exodus 23:25
segments: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

entries.title: Exodus 23:26
segments: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

words.text: There shall nothing cast their young

entries.title: Exodus 23:27
segments: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee. {backs: Heb. neck}

entries.title: Exodus 23:28
segments: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

entries.title: Exodus 23:29
segments: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

words.text: I will not drive them out

entries.title: Exodus 23:30
segments: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

entries.title: Exodus 23:31
segments: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

words.text: ; and thou shalt drive them out

entries.title: Exodus 23:32
segments: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

words.text: with them, nor with their gods

entries.title: Exodus 23:33
segments: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

words.text: against me: for if thou serve
, it will surely be a snare
